exposure: presence of gastrointestinal tract duplications diagnosed prenatally
symptomatic vs asymptomatic gastrointestinal tract duplications
cohort: The study included 82 patients with gastrointestinal tract duplications diagnosed prenatally who underwent surgery at a specific hospital between January 2016 and December 2023.
finding: Obstruction was the most common complication in prenatally diagnosed GIT duplication, predominantly occurring in the neonatal period, and symptomatic patients require earlier intervention while asymptomatic patients with smaller cysts may be observed or have delayed resection.
gest_age: Median gestational age of 24 weeks at prenatal diagnosis
